chapter: Georgie Auld, Hawkins and Los Angeles
title: Second session: leaving Kirk for Georgie Auld
summary: Resuming, McGhee dates Fats's mouthpiece story to 1943, then leaves Kirk to join Georgie Auld's band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Howard McGhee (11/23/82):
We were talking about the Andy Kirk band and the second time you were in it, and talking about Fats Navarro...
I talked about when we took him to get his mouthpiece, right?
Yeah.
In Chicago.
Right.
Where did I leave off at?
Well, we kind of left off after you had made some statements about him and his playing and his talent. So what year was this? Was this '44?
'43, I think.
Yeah, '43. Maybe the first part of '44, I don't know. But I think it was the last part of '43. Because I left Andy shortly after that, and went with Georgie Auld's band.
Now, that was kind of an all-star band, no?
With Georgie Auld?
Yeah.
Well, he had a bunch of kids...
Right, as his nucleus, but then he added some other people.
McGhee (11/23) - 2
Yeah. He added me and Shadow Wilson and...
Was Oscar Pettiford there, too?
No, he wasn't there.
No, not at all?
Not at all, no. He wasn't there at all.
Maybe he made some records with him.

Yeah, he might have did some records with him. Because I did a date, and I don't even remember the date that I did with Georgie Auld, but I know I did it, because a guy brought me a record with my solo on it.
Do you remember what it was?
